message:
🎉 PichiTV v2.5.0 is here!

✨ Key Highlights:
• 🦋 Interactive Creature Companions — Choose between Ethereal Butterfly, Cyber Hummingbird, Golden Fireflies, or Clean in Settings.
• 📺 10-Foot Smart TV UI & Universal Responsiveness — Fully adaptive scaling from small phones to large TVs with zero cutoff.
• ⏱️ Real Live Digital Clock — Smart 12h/24h clock synced across all screen headers and player HUDs.
• 🖼️ Picture-in-Picture (PiP) — Seamless multitasking with floating player on phone & TV.
• ⚡ Shimmer Skeletons & Instant Crossfade — Instant skeleton loading placeholders and zero-black-flash channel switching.
• 🎨 Dynamic Theme Studio — 5 switchable cyber atmosphere palettes with custom companion glows.
• 🎧 Audio & Subtitle Quick-Pickers — Multi-track audio and subtitle selection right inside Live TV OSD.
• 🍿 100k+ Movie Speedup — Instant disk caching and 60-item chunked streaming on all TV boxes.

Enjoy the most advanced PichiTV experience! 🍿
